artifact_type: AUDIT proposals only; no class additions

candidates.proposed_family: Provisional VIGIL-FF-0012 Objective Pursuit Integrity; family placement requires adjudication.
candidates.mechanism_and_purpose: An AI-mediated workflow materially enables a specifically prohibited harmful capability even though no technical safeguard is shown available or activated. A substantive independently applicable restriction should not disappear from recognition merely because its implementation is absent. This is not a general ban on risky or dual-use work.
draft_recognition_conditions: A then-effective independently established restriction applies to this system, actor, use, scope and time; identify its actual source and relevant threshold, rather than infer it from later harm or disapproval.
Information available in the interaction makes the prohibited use materially ascertainable; do not presume the system saw hidden operator intent.
The system actually supplies code, operational analysis, execution or other assistance that materially enables the restricted capability or use; identify the specific contribution and evidence.

The assistance fails to preserve that restriction through a bounded refusal, safe alternative, escalation or independently authorised exception; the restriction cannot be treated as discharged solely because no implemented control existed.
Materiality rests on actual assistance and the governed capability/risk, without requiring realised casualties, complete deployment, internal malicious intent or an activated-control failure.
draft_success_recognition: An actual request/pathway materially tests the same independently applicable restriction.
The observed response preserves the restriction through proportionate refusal, safe redirection or a valid bounded exception while respecting any independent support duties.
Request context, response and actual permitted/prohibited effect support the bounded result, rather than an announced policy alone.
draft_exclusions: No independently applicable restriction, or its historical applicability is unresolved: preserve an evidence question.
Legitimate dual-use work, authorised defensive research or controlled evaluation that falls within an independently valid exception.
Generic assistance or incidental AI use with no evidenced material capability contribution.
Purely hypothetical capability or an unexecuted plan without material assistance.
The only distinct mechanism is nonactivation of an available control (FC038) or insufficient effect of an activated one (FC083); use those where sufficient.
The only distinct defect is unauthorised action/authority carryover, ungrounded consequential guidance, protected-information access or credential custody; assess the corresponding existing class.
Harm, country, affiliation or operator accusation alone without the restriction/context/contribution tests.

distinction_from_neighbours.FC038/FC083: These require available/applicable or validly operative control state. Their explicit scope exclusions can leave substantive prohibited assistance outside admission.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC087: Covers independently applicable vulnerability-responsive human-facing protection, not general assistance with a prohibited technical capability.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC065/FC062: Accurate well-grounded technical assistance can still enable a prohibited use; factual inaccuracy or impaired deliberation is not required.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC064: Tests an otherwise valid objective selecting an inadmissible pathway. The concern here can be that the assisted objective/use itself is independently prohibited.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC002/FC003: Require a specific capability-to-authority or original-to-changed-scope mechanism; prohibited assistance does not automatically establish either.

supporting_occurrences.status: Primary suspected coverage omission; actual assistance reported; exact historical restriction and model-visible context require confirmation.
Same occurrence support, not independent recurrence.

counterexamples_and_boundaries: INC135 E001/E002: local authorised security research and misleading CTF framing require exact permission/control tests, not blanket harmful-capability exclusion.
INC117: legitimate forensic assistance should remain available; false-positive safety restrictions are separately represented by FC043.
INC094 E002: hostile unattended configuration is material, but no independent mandatory approval requirement has yet been established.
INC120's simulation/prototype maturity is not proof of fielded casualties, and does not by itself make actual capability assistance immaterial.
candidates.prior_proposal_comparison: OPEN. Compare all existing taxonomy-gap records, design notes, rejected proposals and issues133/150/170/171 before claiming novelty. The current audit has not completed that comparison.
candidates.confidence: Medium that a substantive coverage question warrants review; low-to-medium that a new class is needed/admissible before historical restriction and context are confirmed. One independent supporting occurrence, not a repeated validated omission.
unresolved_questions: What exact then-effective restriction applied to this assistance and system?
What did the system know about the restricted use?
Can FC064 cover an inadmissible assisted objective without distorting its pathway distinction?
Would a substantive control-obligation clarification be preferable to a new class?
Which actual refusal/safe-alternative occurrences would test positive recognition? No confirmed positive C01 occurrence is claimed.
candidates.status: Candidate for human adjudication; not an admitted class or a finding that all recognition facts are established.
candidates.comparator_correction: INC127 E002 concerns a PaperCut campaign, not weapons assistance. It is a neighbouring cyber-authority/control comparator only and supplies no independent weapons-use recurrence. This corrects any broader reading of the provisional consolidation.

previous_proposal_comparison.finding: Earlier non-admission tests absent control/monitor/routing facts. That conclusion is preserved; it does not independently settle substantive assistance coverage.
Vulnerability-responsive duty/signals question is adjacent, but FC087 is specifically human-facing protection. Do not enlarge it to all prohibited technical uses without adjudication.
Same source-first no-mapping problem; this audit contributes evidence rather than duplicating the issue.

candidates.proposed_family: Provisional VIGIL-FF-0002 Provenance/Lineage Integrity; consider FF0004 Audit Integrity if implemented as an FC027 boundary clarification.
candidates.status: Boundary clarification preferred first; new-class draft below is a conditional alternative only.
candidates.mechanism_and_purpose: When a recording or other source is transformed into a factual record under a material coverage/fidelity requirement, preserve relevant events, negation, uncertainty and risk-bearing context. Source links and provisional draft labels do not by themselves make a materially distorted representation faithful. This is not a demand that every summary repeat everything.
draft_recognition_conditions: An AI-mediated process transforms identified antecedent evidence into a factual report, summary or comparable evidentiary representation.

An independently established task, record purpose or governing process requires preservation of specified materially relevant information or meaning; state that requirement and why the omitted/inverted matter is material.

Source/output comparison establishes a material omission, inversion, unsupported insertion or loss of a limiting qualification, rather than merely a difference in wording, compression or evaluative preference.
The defect exists in the representation at its required review/communication point and is not faithfully qualified as an intentional scope limit appropriate to that use.

The mismatch materially impairs the evidentiary purpose or creates a material review/decision risk; downstream final reliance, realised harm and internal root cause are not necessary unless separately required by the proposed scope.
draft_success_recognition: The same source-to-record transformation and material preservation requirement are actually tested.
The output preserves the required material facts, negation, uncertainty and role/context boundaries or explicitly and appropriately bounds an intentional exclusion.
Paired source/output review establishes the fidelity result at the required point, without treating mere source availability, human sign-off or more detail as proof.
draft_exclusions: Ordinary lossy summarisation that preserves everything material to its stated legitimate purpose.
Fiction, brainstorming or expressly non-evidentiary generation without a factual preservation requirement.
The allegedly missing detail is absent from the supplied source or outside the independently established record purpose.
Only authorship/speaker attribution is defective: use FC010 where sufficient.
Only target/person binding is defective: use FC015 where sufficient.
Only missing source links/transform lineage prevents reconstruction: use FC011/013.
A captured audit record has an integrity-degrading alteration already covered by FC027; prefer that existing class if its actual scope faithfully includes the derivative.
Only deficient assurance/promotion or an omitted required verification is established: use FC062/016.
A reviewer later detects/corrects a draft error: that may be a successful review occurrence, not proof the original representation was faithful.

distinction_from_neighbours.FC027: Potentially already adequate for a materially degraded derivative audit record. Clarify whether preserved originals and detectable transformations preclude failure or simply preserve separate integrity properties. Do not assume every summary is audit evidence.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC011/013: Lineage can be intact while the derived factual content loses material meaning. Conversely, an incorrect conclusion alone is excluded from synthesis traceability.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC062/016: Concern may arise in a provisional draft before any unsupported promotion or false verification-completion claim.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC022: If an event was never captured in any required evidence route, capture is the narrower issue. Here the original source is retained and the derivative loses material content.
distinction_from_neighbours.FC010/015: Attribution and target-binding errors already have coverage; avoid repackaging those as the sole justification for a new class.

supporting_occurrences.status: Primary suspected omission; aggregate evaluation and secondary report available, paired recordings/drafts unavailable.
Potential positive comparator for correctly surfaced material detail; not a confirmed success without source comparison.
Neighbouring false attributed statement; FC010 reconsideration, not independent proof that a new class is needed.

counterexamples_and_boundaries: A faithful short report omits irrelevant background: excluded.
A draft accurately marks that only a specified segment was summarised: evaluate that legitimate scope rather than require a whole-record summary.
An invented judicial quotation attributed to an opinion: FC010/062 may already suffice.
A source recording remains intact and the review detects an omission: source preservation/review may succeed while the derivative needs correction.
A user merely dislikes a summary emphasis without a material task-grounded omission: excluded.

previous_proposal_comparison.finding: Earlier tests properly note missing final reliance, omitted-verification proof and damaged original evidence. C02 asks the separate derivative-content question rather than contradicting those recognition failures.
Prior scope/assurance-boundary programme is adjacent; no identical evidence-representation proposal located in the inspected open/closed issue inventory.

candidates.confidence: Medium that the content loss is independently material; low-to-medium that a new class is distinct from defensible FC027 clarification. No repeated independent C02 occurrence or validated positive counterpart established.
unresolved_questions: Recover paired evidence and original task-prescribed coverage.
Does FC027 already recognise the actual derivative record and degradation at its intended abstraction level?
Would a normative clarification of derivative evidence be narrower and sufficient?
Where is the minimum materiality threshold between normal summary selection and representation failure?

other_mechanism_groups.treatment: Existing-class reconsideration, not a missing positive-class family
other_mechanism_groups.boundary: Actual intervention/effect or completed verification/delivery needed. Announcements, generic non-exploitation and all-system recovery demands are inappropriate substitutes.

examples: INC158 authentication tokens and post edit
INC208 E005 broader exposed harness secrets
other_mechanism_groups.boundary: Actual secret retrievability or unauthorised information operation does not require later impersonation/exfiltration beyond what the class requires. Keep unrelated clusters separately attributed.

other_mechanism_groups.mechanism: Service function, workflow state and independent obligation
other_mechanism_groups.treatment: Clarify FC084/035 boundary first; investigate duties for other cases
other_mechanism_groups.boundary: An actual obligation/threshold and feasible response matter; harm or availability of a feature alone is insufficient. A security reason does not settle every independent continuity question.
Whether the original assessment is relied upon as current assurance for a materially changed route; relate to preserved E002 gap without duplicating it.

other_mechanism_groups.mechanism: Correction of an acknowledged nonessential interaction direction
other_mechanism_groups.treatment: Materiality/coverage clarification, not a new class proposal
other_mechanism_groups.boundary: No invented continuity transition, grave decision or vulnerability duty. Distinguish persistent material user-control interference from ordinary annoyance and justified protection.
Establish actual notice duty, lawful minimisation constraints and feasible alternatives. Do not require retaining reidentification keys merely to classify.

other_mechanism_groups.mechanism: Safe adoption of reusable operating instructions
other_mechanism_groups.treatment: Existing FC078 hypothesis; obtain adoption/transition evidence
other_mechanism_groups.boundary: Reuse alone is not invalid continuity; distinguish material carried state from independent similar mistakes.
Alteration intent is not required by FC027; traceable correction is different from evidence degradation. Completion of one correction does not prove propagation to every governed point.

pre_existing_gap_comparison.treatment: Previously recorded common gap; do not propose six new classes or erase it. Some are the same underlying evaluator issue, so not six independent occurrences.
Existing gap preserved; FC043 excludes valid activation with excessive scope. Not automatically the same concept as C01 or INC211 preference adherence.
Relate to FC020 clarification, preserving the prior gap.
Preserved pre-existing gap; not readjudicated as part of the no-mapping population.
Previously recorded questions remain; copying or following a payload is not automatically independently corroborated assurance or a genuine historical compaction.
